info.title: Tessera Analytics API
info.description: Customer-facing REST API for Tessera Analytics' gold Hyperliquid datasets. Browse the catalog, list partitions, and mint presigned download URLs. Download this document at `/v1/openapi.json` to generate a client.

servers.description: Same-origin (production fronts the API via CloudFront)

get.description:
Public (no API key). Returns every customer-facing dataset with an intuitive
summary and its tier — the high-level catalog. Drill into
`/v1/catalog/{asset}` for the per-column data dictionary. This is
documentation only; it advertises Pro datasets to everyone. Actual data
access stays gated on `/v1/datasets/*`.

Public (no API key). Returns the full dictionary for one dataset: dataset
prose plus every column's type, nullability, technical description, and
plain-English meaning, grouped for presentation. Unknown or non-customer-
facing assets return 404.

Returns every gold dataset visible to the caller's policy, with a partition
count, the distinct coins, and the month range available.

Returns the partitions (coin × month) of `asset` visible to the caller,
optionally narrowed by the `coin` and `month` query filters.

parameters.name: coin
parameters.description: Only return partitions for this coin, e.g. `BTC`.

parameters.name: month
parameters.description: Only return partitions for this month (`YYYY-MM`).

403.description: Dataset not permitted by the caller's policy

get.description:
Mints a short-lived presigned URL for the parquet object of a single
`(asset, coin, month)` partition. By default this **302-redirects** to that
URL, so `curl -L`/`wget` download the file in one step. Send
`Accept: application/json` to get the URL (and its expiry) as a JSON body
instead — useful for programmatic callers.

200.description: Presigned download URL as JSON. Returned only when the request sends `Accept: application/json`.

302.description: Redirect (Location header) to the presigned parquet URL. The default — follow it with `curl -L`.

403.description: Dataset not permitted by the caller's policy

404.description: Partition not found or hidden by policy

get.description:
Same as [`download_url`] but for datasets with no coin dimension (one row per
month). The path has no `{coin}` segment.

parameters.name: asset
parameters.description: Market-wide dataset name (coinless; none currently published)

200.description: Presigned download URL as JSON. Returned only when the request sends `Accept: application/json`.

302.description: Redirect (Location header) to the presigned parquet URL. The default — follow it with `curl -L`.

403.description: Dataset not permitted by the caller's policy

404.description: Partition not found or hidden by policy

CatalogEntry.description:
A dataset's catalog card (the high-level list view). Drill into
`/v1/catalog/{name}` for the full column dictionary.

tier.description: Display tier badge (`free` / `pro`), derived from the access policy.

generated_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp the dictionary was generated.

ColumnDoc.description:
One column's dictionary entry: the engineering facts (type/nullability/how
it's computed) plus the plain-English `meaning` (what it is and why you'd care).

description.description: Technical description — *how* the column is computed. May be absent.

meaning.description: Plain-English meaning — *what* the column is and why it's useful.

nullable.description: Whether the column may be null.

ColumnGroup.description: A labelled section of columns within a dataset.

label.description: Section heading, or `null` for a single unlabelled group.

meaning.description:
Group-level plain-English meaning, used for large column families (e.g.
the residualized factor backbone) where a per-column line adds no value.

window.description:
Temporal window of this group's fields relative to the timestamp label:
one of `point_in_time`, `backward`, `forward`, `contemporaneous`,
`static`. Null when the dataset-level `temporal.convention` covers them.

DatasetDoc.description: One dataset's catalog entry + full data dictionary.

cadence.description: Granularity + partitioning, e.g. "1-minute bars, partitioned per (coin, month)".

column_groups.description: Columns, grouped for presentation, in schema order.

description.description: Longer prose — the dictionary page header.

direct_answer.description:
40-60 word keyword-first lead answer — the definitional "what is this"
blurb, and the strongest AI-citation extraction target. Defaulted for
forward/backward compatibility with snapshots predating the field.

keywords.description: Per-dataset discovery keywords (schema.org keywords on the web).

seo_title.description:
Keyword-first SEO title tag (web `<title>`). Defaulted so older snapshots
without the field still deserialize.

summary.description: One-line intuitive summary — the catalog card.

temporal.description:
Machine-readable timestamp/interval contract: what the label marks and
how to join without leaking the future. Defaulted so snapshots predating
the field still deserialize.

tier.description:
Display tier: `free` or `pro`. Re-derived from `policy.rs` on read, so it
always matches actual entitlement regardless of the on-disk value.

use_case.description: One-line "what you'd use it for" (buyer-intent) copy.

partition_count.description: Number of partitions visible to the caller.

generated_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp the catalog manifest was generated.

expires_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp at which the URL expires.

url.description: Presigned Tigris URL for the parquet object.

ErrorBody.description:
The error response body. Every error variant serialises to this shape —
a single machine-readable `error` code. Declared as a real struct (rather
than the inline `json!` below) only so it can be referenced as a response
`body` in the OpenAPI spec; `into_response` still emits the same JSON.

coin.description:
Coin symbol, e.g. `BTC`. Absent (`None`) for market-wide (coinless)
datasets whose parquet is one row per month with no coin dimension —
none are currently published.

coverage.description:
Fraction of the expected time-buckets that are populated (`rows` ÷
elapsed buckets) — the tradable-universe signal: the 1-minute grid is
trade-driven and gappy on thin coins, the hourly grids near-complete.
Present alongside `rows`; `None` elsewhere.

is_open.description:
Whether this is the current, in-progress month — its parquet is
re-materialised daily (part-month freshness) and therefore grows under
the customer. Absent (`None`) in older (v1) manifests.

modified_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp of the last write, if known.

rows.description:
Row count (parquet `num_rows`). Present only for the time-series tiles
(`gold_ohlcv_1m`, `gold_funding_1h`, `gold_positioning_1h`) from v3
manifests; `None` elsewhere and in older manifests.

asset.description: Dataset name the partitions belong to.

generated_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp the catalog manifest was generated.

Temporal.description:
The dataset's temporal contract — what the timestamp column marks and the
look-ahead-safety rules for joining. Mirror of the resolver's `temporal`
block (`semantic/__init__.py`).

label.description:
What the label marks: one of `interval_start`, `interval_end`,
`snapshot`, `forecast_target`.

timestamp_field.description: Which column carries the label, e.g. `time`, `day`, `month_start`.

api_key.description: Raw API key sent as a bearer token.

tags.name: catalog
tags.description: Public data catalog and per-column data dictionary (no API key required).

tags.name: datasets
tags.description: Browse and download gold datasets (authenticated with an API key).
